description:
Create a demonstration of live DVB-T2 signal reception using SDR hardware (RTL-SDR or HackRF). This validates the complete FEC chain with real-world RF signals rather than simulated AWGN.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Build live DVB-T2 reception demo with SDR hardware” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Build live DVB-T2 reception demo with SDR hardware
